verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents an official MCP server that exposes controls, tests, vendors, frameworks and risks as tools. Any MCP client (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor) can use it to look things up and take actions in plain language, with an OAuth-style sign-in and no manual secrets. A probe confirms the official repo exists. Missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language/chat interface (natural-language operation requires an external MCP client), detail on which write actions are supported, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
